categories.name: Rebase Tokens
categories.content: Rebase tokens are cryptocurrencies that are usually pegged to a certain value, and they control their prices by algorithmically adjusting their token’s circulating supply.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: MetaDAO Launchpad
categories.content: MetaDAO Launchpad (https://metadao.fi/) is a Solana-based platform designed to facilitate decentralized project launches and funding, leveraging futarchy-based governance to align community and market incentives.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Solana Token-2022
categories.content: Solana Token-2022 is a new token standard on Solana that provides additional fungible and non-fungible token functionality.

categories.name: ST0x Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized public equities and capital market instruments issued on the st0x.io platform.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: Coinbase Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized U.S. equities issued by Coinbase and deployed on Base under its B20 tokenized equity standard, launched in 2026 for non-U.S. customers. Tokens are identified by a "C" suffix appended to the underlying ticker and can be traded onchain on DEXs.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Product (ETPs)
categories.content: The Tokenized Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs) category includes cryptoassets that represent on-chain versions of traditional Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs). ETPs are traditional financial securities that track underlying securities, an index, or other financial products.
